summary: ABC Supply Phase 4 (Notifications + Public Relay Webhook Ingress) end-to-end verification against deployed backend. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_abc_supply_p4_api.py (16 tests, ALL PASS) covering: (1) webhook register+reconcile (single webhook_id MOCK-WEBHOOK-1, has_secret=true, events=[ORDER_UPDATE,ORDER_INVOICED], secret never exposed on /status), (2) public ingress auth 401 for missing/wrong Authorization AND 200 without JWT when secret is correct, (3) ORDER_UPDATE routes to PO by purchaseOrderNumber, updates abc_order_status='Scheduled' + abc_normalized_status='scheduled', (4) IDEMPOTENCY: identical eventId returns {duplicate:true} and PO is NOT mutated twice, (5) OFFLINE->RECONNECT: simulate-offline=false + POST event => queued (PO status unchanged) => reconnect returns delivered>=1 and PO becomes Shipped; re-reconnect returns delivered=0 (delivered-once), (6) NO AUTO-RECEIVING (CRITICAL): after Shipped, PO.status stays 'ordered' (NOT received/partially_received) and every line.received_quantity=0 — Receiving still requires manual workflow, (7) ORDER_INVOICED via Authorization header AND via data.apiKey both work (docs-ambiguity handled), invoice appears in /events/{po_id}, (8) Unmatched purchaseOrderNumber => routing='unmatched' and no PO mutated, (9) RBAC: sales user gets 403 on register/status/reconnect. Ran full regression: 74/74 pass (p1 10, p2 9, p2_api 14, p3 7, p3_api 14, p4 5, relay 15). Frontend verified via Playwright on PO-0097 (which had the full webhook lifecycle): abc-order-panel opens with abc-order-status showing 'Shipped'+MOCK-CONF-10001, abc-invoice shows MOCK-INVOICE-555 & 556 with dates, abc-activity lists all 6 events (Acknowledged->Scheduled->Picking->Shipped->Invoiced x2), auto-update note present, abc-refresh-status clickable and functional. All 11 review items PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: abc_webhooks.py:197 — chained ternary on api_key extraction is hard to read: `data.get('apiKey') or (data.get('webhookDetails') or [{}])[0].get('apiKey') if isinstance(data.get('webhookDetails'), list) else data.get('apiKey')`. Precedence works but a small helper `_extract_api_key(data)` would improve readability and testability.

_ONLINE flag is a module-level in-memory dict (routers/abc_webhooks.py:45). Acceptable for the single-process desktop mock (explicitly documented), but multi-worker deployments would lose 'offline' state across workers — flag for the eventual real Relay/multi-node build.

AbcOrderPanel.jsx:26 swallows all errors from /events/{po_id} silently (`catch (e) { /* none */ }`). If the endpoint 500s, the panel will look fine but silently miss activity/invoice — consider logging or a subtle toast.

purchasing.py:368 truncates PO number to 20 chars when building the ABC payload (`po.number[:20]`). If PO numbers ever exceed 20 chars, the webhook match on purchaseOrderNumber could still succeed (matches full local number) but the ABC-side echo may differ; leaving as noted in iter_26.
